note: Equibase explicitly treats speed horses as front-runners/pacesetters. Generic Pacesetter is retired into RUN-009 Front-runner; tactical pacemaker remains RUN-046.
Equibase pace-style material defines Stalker as sitting within striking range behind the leaders; scope remains North American Flat.
Equibase explicitly defines Presser as a horse with early speed that forces the issue while letting speed horses set the initial pace.
USTA directly describes the pocket position behind the leader on the rail and its advantages/boxing-in risk.
USTA explains cover as the positioning advantage enjoyed behind another horse, especially second-over behind first-over.
USTA current chart calls list Parked Out and its fan guide explains the outside parked position as covering extra ground.
